correctness.rationale: Direct uniform first-two-column counting gives rank-one additive Fourier moment -u and rank-two v=u/(q^(n-1)-1) for all prime powers q. The nonzero-coordinate Gram is A I-(u+v)(P tensor J_(q-1))+v J, with rook matrix P, yielding A,R,I and 2x2 block eigenvalues λ± with multiplicities summing to 1+n²(q-1). R>0 follows from a geometric sum and the 2x2 block is positive since zero-entry count of invertible matrices is nonconstant. An exact characteristic-polynomial factor n(q-1)u²(1+t)(2q-n-(q-1)(n-2)t) establishes λmax=I for n<2q and λ+ for n>=2q, while λmin=λ-. Fixed-q root expansion gives κ²=1+2n sqrt(q(q-1))q^-n+O_q(q^-n). Independent complete enumeration/Gram diagonalization for (q,n)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3) reproduces spectra within 7e-16; these finite cases do not prove the infinite theorem.
